description: Advanced personal finance strategies, wealth building, and financial independence

wealth_building_principles.live_below_means: Spend less than you earn; savings rate is the most powerful lever
wealth_building_principles.compound_interest: Einstein called it the eighth wonder; $10,000 at 7% for 40 years = $149,745
wealth_building_principles.time_in_market: Long-term investing beats timing the market; 90%+ of returns from S&P 500 since 1926 came from 25 best years
wealth_building_principles.automate: Remove decisions and willpower; automate savings and investments
wealth_building_principles.avoid_lifestyle_inflation: Keep spending flat as income rises; capture raises as additional savings

components.fi: Accumulate 25× annual expenses; can live off 4% withdrawal rate (Trinity Study)

variants.lean_fire: Minimal spending; retire on $1M or less
variants.coast_fire: Enough saved that compound growth reaches retirement target without additional contributions

fire_movement.four_percent_rule: Portfolio lasting 30+ years with 4% annual withdrawal; based on historical stock/bond returns

milestones.first_100k: Hardest; takes longest; trust the process
milestones.1m: Financial independence threshold for many lean lifestyles

tax_optimization.tax_loss_harvesting: Sell losing investments to offset capital gains; replace with similar (not identical) investments
tax_optimization.asset_location: Put tax-inefficient assets in tax-advantaged accounts; growth stocks in taxable
tax_optimization.roth_conversion: Convert traditional IRA to Roth during low-income years; pay tax now vs later
tax_optimization.qualified_dividends: Taxed at lower capital gains rate vs ordinary income
tax_optimization.backdoor_roth: For high earners who exceed Roth income limits; make non-deductible traditional IRA then convert
tax_optimization.mega_backdoor: After-tax 401k contributions + in-service rollover to Roth; up to $43,500 extra 2024

real_estate.primary_residence: Largest purchase; should consider both financial and lifestyle factors

investment_property.cap_rate: Net Operating Income / Property Value; target 5%+ in most markets
investment_property.cash_on_cash: Annual cash flow / initial cash invested
investment_property.1031_exchange: Defer capital gains by reinvesting in like-kind property

real_estate.reits: Real Estate Investment Trusts; invest in real estate without being landlord; liquid
real_estate.house_hacking: Live in one unit of multi-family property; rent others to offset mortgage

insurance_optimization.term_vs_whole_life: Term for pure death benefit; whole life almost never better for building wealth
insurance_optimization.umbrella: Cheap extra liability protection beyond home/auto; recommend $1M+ for HNW individuals
insurance_optimization.hsa_triple_tax: Health Savings Account; pre-tax in, tax-free growth, tax-free out for medical; invest long-term
insurance_optimization.long_term_care: Consider in 50s; nursing home costs $100k+/year; Medicaid planning alternative

estate_planning.will: Directs asset distribution; names guardian for minor children
estate_planning.living_trust: Avoids probate; maintains privacy; useful for complex situations
estate_planning.poa: Power of Attorney; designate who makes financial decisions if incapacitated
estate_planning.beneficiary_designations: Override wills; update after major life events (marriage, divorce, children)
